topic: Chintu ka chhota surprise (Tap tap tap karo)
format: bouncy sensory sound rhyme (clap, pop, boing, freeze!)
description: Join Chintu and Mithu for a fun, bouncy surprise reveal in this colorful kids' rhyme. Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers to dance along!
learning: Teaches sensory anticipation, counting, and simple interactive Hindi-English vocabulary.

scenes.text: Arrey! Is magic box mein kya chhupa hai?
scenes.image_prompt: 3D cartoon CGI, small round orange baby elephant Chintu with blue scarf looking curiously at a sparkling floating wooden box, vibrant meadow background, 9:16 portrait.

scenes.text: Tap tap tap, chalo milke karte hain knock!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu the elephant using his trunk to tap on the glowing box, Mithu the green parrot with a red cap hovering excitedly nearby, bright sunny day.

scenes.text: One, two, three, ab dekho surprise!
scenes.image_prompt: Close up on the box lid starting to pop open with golden sparkles floating out, Chintu and Mithu leaning in with big wide sparkly eyes.

scenes.text: Boing boing hop, nikla ek pyara balloon!
scenes.image_prompt: A giant bouncy colorful balloon popping out of the box, Chintu jumping in joy, dynamic action shot.

scenes.text: Pop pop pop, let's dance to the tune!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu dancing around the floating balloon, confetti falling, very high energy, happy expressions.

scenes.text: Freeze! Ab ruko aur dekho kya hua?
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu standing perfectly still in a funny pose, the balloon hovering above them, whimsical magical lighting.

scenes.text: Wow! Chintu ka surprise toh bahut bada hai!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu laughing and clapping his feet, Mithu fluttering wings, bright rainbow in the background, pure toddler joy.

scenes.text: Ruko! Magic box mein phir se dekho...
scenes.image_prompt: The magic box starts glowing again, Chintu looking directly at the camera with a playful wink, seamless transition setup.
